data.name: Annice
data.gender_notes: Annice is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'agnis', meaning grace or favor. In the New Testament, Anne is the name of a prophetess who was present at the presentation of Jesus in the temple. The name Annice carries the meaning “Grace, Favor” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Annice usually hope their child will grow to embody grace, favor and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine favor and grace.
data.etymology: Annice belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Grace, Favor.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Annice total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: אניס
in_hebrew.meaning: חן וחסד במשמעות הקרובה ל אנה או חננה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אניס הוא שם עברי שמשמעותו קרובה ל חננה או אנה, ומבטא חן וחסד אלוהיים. השם מופיע ברשימות שמות הנשים בתנוך ובמסורת היהודית והנוצרית כאחד. השם אניס קשור לנושא המשפחה והאמהות.

in_greek.name: Ανίκη
in_greek.meaning: Όμοια με την Χάρη ή την Ευχαριστία
in_greek.long_meaning: Η Ανίκη είναι όνομα που σχετίζεται με την Χάρη ή την Ευχαριστία, και εκφράζει την αγάπη και το έλεος του Θεού. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα Ανίκη ήταν δημοφιλές και συμβόλιζε την πνευματική χαρά και την προσήλια προς τον Θεό.

in_latin.name: Annice
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Annice is derived from Hebrew origins and signifies a gracious and merciful nature. In early Christian tradition, the name conveyed a sense of divine favor and love. Throughout history, Annice has been used in various cultural contexts to denote a person of compassion and kindness.

in_english.name: Annice
in_english.meaning: Gracious, beloved, and merciful Christian name
in_english.long_meaning: The Christian name Annice is rooted in Hebrew and Greek traditions, conveying a sense of divine grace and mercy. Historically, the name has been associated with compassion, kindness, and spiritual favor. In modern Christian cultures, Annice symbolizes a gentle and loving personality, cherished by her community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Annice carries an elegant and timeless charm, often associated with grace, poise, and a sophisticated charm. While the name has its derivation from Greek origins, it has been adopted and popularized in the Western world, particularly in the Christian tradition. This name has served as a reminder of the Christian virtue of grace and kindness and has been a popular choice for Christian parents seeking to bestow a meaningful name upon their child.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Annice echoes the virtues of grace, favor, and prophecy. Biblically, the name is associated with Anne, a prophetess mentioned in the New Testament, who was present at the presentation of Jesus in the temple. This name, therefore, carries a spiritual significance that connects to the divine and the sacred. Annice can inspire those who bear the name to live a virtuous life and be a beacon of light and kindness to those around them, just as the biblical Anne was a beacon of prophecy and faith in the presence of the infant Jesus.
